title: Retirement Accounts from Paychecks
subtitle: Your HSA, 457 and 401(k) each grow with every Rockford paycheck by what goes in through payroll, and Reminders asks you every six months to type the real balances. One upgrade, then two quick checks.
intro: After the pull request merges, the code is already in your Sheet. I have already put the settings on the three accounts; the upgrade adds the column headers and the dropdowns.
**What does not change:** no transactions, paychecks or other balances. Accounts the bank feed updates are never touched by this.

steps.text: In the Sheet, open **File → Version history → Name current version** and name it `Before retirement accounts 2026-11-13`.
Open the **App Setup** tab and check that **Build Script Version** reads `1.18.1`. If it shows an older number, wait a minute and reload the Sheet.
steps.note: This upgrade also covers everything from yesterday and today if you have not run one since.

steps.text: Open **Finance Tracker → Upgrade workbook (keeps data)** and confirm.
Open **Accounts** and scroll right to the last two columns, **Payroll Deposit From (Source ID)** and **Payroll Deposit per Paycheck**.
steps.done: The HealthEquity HSA, the State of MI 457 and the State of MI 401(k) rows each show EXP-003 (the Rockford paycheck) and an amount. The 401(k) amount includes what Rockford adds.

steps.text: From now on, each Rockford paycheck adds those amounts at the sync after it lands in checking. Nothing to do on payday.
steps.note: Investment gains and losses are not seen this way. Every few months, type the balance Voya shows into **Current Balance** on each plan's row; Last Updated changes to that day and counting starts again from there.

steps.text: Plaid does not support your Voya plans, so the 457 and 401(k) stay typed by hand. Every six months the **Reminders** tab (and the monthly reminder email) lists each of them, and the HSA, with the date it was last updated.
steps.note: When it does, log in to Voya and HealthEquity and type each balance in **Current Balance** on the Accounts tab. The reminder clears itself, and the paycheck additions count from that day. The number of months is on App Setup (Balance reminder after).
steps.done: Open **Reminders** after the upgrade. The Acorns account may already be listed, because it has no balance yet; type its balance the same way, or tell me to leave it out.
